summary: Phase 0-B benchmark suitability and multi-step research decision feasibility completed. DiscoveryWorld selected as primary environment (installable, multi-step, graded scoring, 8+ scientific domains). 12 calibration episodes run with rule-based agent across 4 task families. Score variation detected (Reactor Lab: 2/11). Multi-step loop verified (14 decision points/episode). CONDITIONAL GO recommendation with conditions for LLM integration and domain independence verification. R3 erratum documented without history modification.

environment.agent_note: Rule-based agent used for environment verification and calibration. LLM agent (DeepSeek) to be integrated in next phase.

evaluation_provenance.leakage_risk: criticalHypotheses and criticalQuestions exposed in scorecard (mitigation needed)

cost.note: Rule-based agent used; no API calls. LLM integration would cost ~$0.05-0.50 per episode.

tests.notes: 82 tests: 13 R2B adapter (multi-step loop, isolation, budget, DiscoveryWorld integration), 14 R3 scoring isolation, 12 R2 downloader, 19 R1 evaluator, 24 safeguards.

acceptance_detail.R2B-01: R3 erratum documents all defects (timeout hardcoding, CSV/JSON mismatch, exception coercion, gold junction). No history modified.
acceptance_detail.R2B-02: DiscoveryWorld and ScienceAgentBench evaluated with executable evidence. Suitability matrix created.
acceptance_detail.R2B-03: DiscoveryWorld runs end-to-end: load scenario → act → observe → score. 12 episodes completed.
acceptance_detail.R2B-04: Multi-step loop verified: 14 decision points per episode. No gold access in adapter (tested).
acceptance_detail.R2B-05: Score variation detected (0-2). Reactor Lab partial success shows discriminative power.
acceptance_detail.R2B-06: 82 tests pass. Budgets, seeds, costs recorded. Strategy labeled as hand-authored feasibility intervention.
acceptance_detail.R2B-07: CONDITIONAL GO recommendation. Domain independence and LLM integration conditions documented.

decision_conditions: Integrate LLM agent (DeepSeek) to test strategy interventions
Verify domain independence (methodological, not just thematic)
Run pilot with LLM to estimate effect size
limitations: Rule-based agent used (not LLM) — shows potential but not strategy effects
criticalHypotheses leakage risk not fully mitigated
